summary.en: Korean messenger. The Microsoft Store package offers only x64 and x86 installers, so it runs under Prism.
summary.zh-TW: 南韓常用的通訊軟體。Microsoft Store 套件只提供 x64 與 x86 安裝程式，在 Arm 上以 Prism 轉譯執行。

caveats.en: No Arm64 build is listed. Linaro's catalog records it as working under emulation, but I did not test it on RTX Spark.
caveats.zh-TW: Store 未列出 Arm64 版本。Linaro 目錄記錄為轉譯可運作，但未在 RTX Spark 上實測。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。
